name: auriga-git-guards
description: Workflow guardrails for the git lifecycle: `gh pr create` / `gh pr ready` body-snapshot injection plus a commit-reminder hook that nudges agents at semantic boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Three hooks for the git lifecycle: commit-reminder nudges the agent to commit at semantic boundaries when uncommitted diff crosses size thresholds; pr-create-guard injects a body snapshot after `gh pr create` so the agent can self-verify the five-element PR description (scope / acceptance criteria / design decisions / risks / TODOs); pr-ready-guard blocks `gh pr ready` on structural problems (stray planning docs, unfinalized active specs, unpushed commits) and otherwise injects the body snapshot. Bundles the git-workflow skill describing the full lifecycle. Designed for the auriga workflow in https://github.com/Ben2pc/auriga-cli.
